name: When do I need professional storm damage restoration versus DIY repairs?

mainEntity.name: When do I need professional storm damage restoration versus DIY repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional storm damage restoration is recommended for any damage that compromises your home's structural integrity, involves significant water intrusion, or requires specialized equipment and expertise. This includes roof damage, extensive water damage that could lead to mold, and damage from fallen trees. DIY repairs are generally limited to very minor, cosmetic issues that do not pose a safety risk or require specific industry knowledge. Attempting complex repairs yourself can void warranties, lead to improper fixes, or cause further damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional restoration is needed for structural damage, significant water intrusion, or complex issues; DIY is only for very minor, cosmetic repairs.
